title: A cache that does not keep things alive
hints: Store `std::map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<Texture>>`. A `weak_ptr` does not count as an owner, so the cache never keeps a texture alive.
`weak.lock()` returns a `shared_ptr` that is empty if the texture is gone; `weak.expired()` asks the same question without making one.

A `std::map` (from `<map>`) looks a value up by its key. `cache[name]` gives the entry for `name`, creating an empty one if there is none; `cache.find(name)` returns `cache.end()` when the name is missing, without creating anything (use it in the `const` functions). `cache.size()` counts the entries, and `std::erase_if(cache, [](const auto& entry) { return entry.second.expired(); })` removes the entries whose texture is gone and returns how many (`entry.first` is the name, `entry.second` the `weak_ptr`).
